publish.scheduled_empty_hint: A script waits here once its status is approved; the script page is where that happens.
publish.published_empty_hint: A post shows up here after the platform collection brings it back, newest first.
publish.no_metrics_note: Plays, likes and the rest come from the platform’s own collection — nothing is typed in here.
publish.save_failed: The publish time wasn’t saved. Try again.
publish.push_failed: The topic couldn’t move to publishing. Try again.
publish.error_description: The approved scripts or the published posts didn’t answer. Check the connection, then try again.

data.note: A snapshot is one day of one post. A figure the platform hasn’t reported yet reads “not collected”, not zero.
data.empty_hint: The first collection fills this page: one row per capture day, per post.
data.post_empty: No snapshot for this post yet
data.post_empty_hint: Add a day by hand, or wait for the next collection run.
data.videos_empty: No works collected for this creator yet
data.zero_hint: The platform reports zero — that is a reading, not a gap
data.form_description: Saving a day that already exists corrects it; it does not add a second row.
data.form_blank_note: A blank field is stored as not collected, not as zero.
data.form_failed: The snapshot wasn’t saved. Try again.
data.error_description: The posts, the snapshots or the works didn’t answer. Check the connection, then try again.
